title: Feedback about torch.aminmax
bug_description: There is the following issue on this page: https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/generated/torch.aminmax.html#torch.aminmax ```py from torch import tensor import torch torch.aminmax(torch.tensor([1, -3, 5])) torch.return_types.aminmax( min=tensor(-3), max=tensor(5) ) ``` error ```py --------------------------------------------------------------------------- TypeError Traceback (most recent call last) Cell In[4], line 5 2 import torch 4 torch.aminmax(torch.tensor([1, -3, 5])) ----> 5 torch.return_types.aminmax( 6 min=tensor(-3), 7 max=tensor(5) 8 ) TypeError: structseq() missing required argument 'sequence' (pos 1) ```
best_code:
from torch import tensor
import torch

torch.aminmax(torch.tensor([1, -3, 5]))
torch.return_types.aminmax(
    min=tensor(-3),
    max=tensor(5)
)
